longDescription: Media Control for D200 is a macOS-only local companion for Ulanzi D200. It shows current-media artwork, title, artist, playback state, and progress; provides transport controls; and controls macOS system volume and mute. Control icons support independent colors. Now Playing adds a playback badge and optional 7 px bottom progress bar. Four artwork tiles form a live 2x2 mosaic and can independently run Previous, Play/Pause, Next, Volume Up, Volume Down, or Mute Toggle without replacing their artwork. The large center display shows artwork and playback details. Ulanzi Studio automatically starts the bundled local D200 bridge when needed. Everything runs on the same Mac through a loopback bridge with no cloud service or account. Current-media data uses private macOS MediaRemote APIs. v2.3.0 is the final planned Media Center feature release; future releases, if needed, are maintenance updates. Local v2.1.0 package, Ulanzi Studio, and physical D200 validation succeeded on the tested setup. Signing, notarization, marketplace publication or acceptance, and compatibility across other macOS, Studio, or device versions remain unproven.
